user.title: Zendo
user.description: This is the companion integration for Zendo. To get started, download the Zendo app on your phone or tablet.

setup_push_notifications.name: Set up push notifications [Internal]
setup_push_notifications.description: Store the JWT token used to authenticate with the Zendo push notification backend. This is typically called by the Zendo mobile app during setup. This is an internal service and should not be called manually.

token.name: Token
token.description: The JWT token for push notifications.

refresh_profiles.name: Refresh people and device groups
refresh_profiles.description: Fetch the people and device groups from the Zendo backend and create their entities: a notification entity for each person, and an event entity for each device group. Only Home Assistant administrators can run this action.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Send a push notification to one or more Zendo people. Device groups can't receive push notifications.

interruption_level.name: Interruption level
interruption_level.description: Optional. Set to "time_sensitive" for time-sensitive notifications or "critical" for critical alerts that bypass Do Not Disturb.

deep_link_destination.name: Deep link destination
deep_link_destination.description: Optional. The ID of a deep link destination. Tapping the notification opens the corresponding view in the Zendo app. Use the list_deep_link_destinations service to see available IDs.

set_deep_link_destinations.name: Set deep link destinations [Internal]
set_deep_link_destinations.description: Store the list of deep link destinations from the Zendo mobile app. This is an internal service and should not be called manually.

destinations.name: Destinations
destinations.description: JSON-encoded array of deep link destinations.

list_deep_link_destinations.name: List deep link destinations
list_deep_link_destinations.description: List stored deep link destinations for use in automations.

ring_doorbell.name: Ring doorbell
ring_doorbell.description: Ring Zendo like a doorbell for the people and device groups you target: shows an in-app alert and plays a ringtone. Only rings on their devices that have the Zendo app open in kiosk mode.

deep_link_destination.name: Camera/Doorbell
deep_link_destination.description: Required. The ID of a security camera deep link destination. The alert shows this camera's snapshot and Answer opens its stream. Use the list_deep_link_destinations service to see available IDs. Only security camera/doorbell destinations are allowed.

sound.name: Ringtone
sound.description: Optional. The ringtone to play. Omit for a silent (visual-only) alert.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Optional. Device output volume (0-100) to set while ringing. Omit to ring at the device's current volume.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Optional. How many times to play the ringtone (1-5). Defaults to 1.

doorbell_action.name: Doorbell action [Internal]
doorbell_action.description: Broadcast a doorbell action to connected Zendo apps. This is an internal service and should not be called manually.

register_managed_device.name: Register managed device [Internal]
register_managed_device.description: Register a managed Zendo device and respond with its managed device ID. Creates or updates the device in the Home Assistant device registry and its sensor entities. This is an internal service called by the Zendo app and should not be called manually.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Required. The profile ID that owns this device.

device_brand.name: Device brand
device_brand.description: Required. The device manufacturer brand (e.g. "Apple"). Can be null.

device_model_name.name: Device model name
device_model_name.description: Required. The device model name (e.g. "iPad Pro"). Can be null.

device_os_version.name: Device OS version
device_os_version.description: Optional. The version of the device operating system (e.g. "18.5"). Can be null.

app_version.name: App version
app_version.description: Required. The Zendo app version running on the device.

managed_device_id.name: Managed device ID
managed_device_id.description: Optional. The managed device ID to use if no managed device is attached to this device yet and the ID is free. Otherwise it's ignored.

unregister_managed_device.name: Unregister managed device [Internal]
unregister_managed_device.description: Mark a managed device as unavailable. The device and its entities remain in Home Assistant but show as unavailable. Responds with whether a managed device is attached to this device. This is an internal service called by the Zendo app and should not be called manually.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Required. The profile ID that owns this device.

managed_device_command_response.name: Managed device command response [Internal]
managed_device_command_response.description: Deliver a JSON-RPC response from a managed device back to the integration. This is an internal service called by the Zendo app and should not be called manually.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Required. The profile ID that owns the responding device.

response.name: Response
response.description: Required. JSON-stringified JSON-RPC 2.0 response object, including the "id" field that correlates with the original command.

update_managed_device_state.name: Update managed device state [Internal]
update_managed_device_state.description: Push a state update from a managed device. Updates the device's sensor entities and resets its online timer. Responds with whether a managed device is attached to this device. This is an internal service called by the Zendo app and should not be called manually.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Required. The profile ID that owns this device.

managed_device_screensaver_configure.name: Configure device screensaver (Kiosk)
managed_device_screensaver_configure.description: Configure the screensaver on a Zendo device. All settings are optional - only the values you provide will be changed, the rest remain unchanged.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Optional. The screensaver mode. "none" disables the screensaver, "dim" reduces brightness but keeps content visible, "black" turns the screen fully dark, "clock" shows a clock on a dark background.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Optional. Minutes of inactivity before the screensaver activates (1-60).

managed_device_screen_configure.name: Configure device screen (Kiosk)
managed_device_screen_configure.description: Configure screen settings on a Zendo device. All settings are optional - only the values you provide will be changed, the rest remain unchanged.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional. Screen brightness (1-100%). With auto-brightness on, this is how bright the screen is in normal room light, and the device adjusts it as the light changes.

managed_device_screen_wake_up.name: Wake up device screen (Kiosk)
managed_device_screen_wake_up.description: Wake the screen on a Zendo device. The screen stays on until the screensaver timer expires.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

managed_device_audio_configure.name: Configure device audio (Kiosk)
managed_device_audio_configure.description: Configure audio settings on a Zendo device. All settings are optional - only the values you provide will be changed, the rest remain unchanged.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

managed_device_app_reload.name: Reload device app (Kiosk)
managed_device_app_reload.description: Reload the Zendo app on a device. Only Home Assistant administrators can run this action.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

managed_device_app_lock.name: Lock device (Kiosk)
managed_device_app_lock.description: Lock a Zendo device with a PIN. Device will require the PIN to unlock locally. Device can also be unlocked remotely using the managed_device_app_unlock service. The device needs a current version of the Zendo app. Only Home Assistant administrators can run this action, and a PIN set here shows in recorded events and traces.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

pin.name: PIN
pin.description: Required. A numeric PIN that must be entered to unlock the device. Must be exactly 4, 6, or 8 digits.

message.name: Lock message
message.description: Optional. A message to display on the lock screen.

managed_device_app_unlock.name: Unlock device (Kiosk)
managed_device_app_unlock.description: Remotely unlock a Zendo device. No PIN is needed for remote unlock. Only Home Assistant administrators can run this action.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

managed_device_auto_brightness_configure.name: Configure device auto-brightness (Kiosk)
managed_device_auto_brightness_configure.description: Turn auto-brightness on or off on a Zendo device. With it on, the device adjusts the screen to the light around it, and the brightness you set is how bright the screen is in normal room light. Devices without a working light sensor are skipped.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Required. Turn auto-brightness on or off.

managed_device_wake_on_approach_configur.name: Configure device wake on approach (Kiosk)
managed_device_wake_on_approach_configur.description: Configure wake on approach on a Zendo device: the screen wakes when someone comes up to it. Provide at least one setting - only the values you provide will be changed, the rest remain unchanged. Devices that can't wake on approach are skipped.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Optional. Turn wake on approach on or off.

sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Optional. How close someone has to come for the screen to wake. Only devices whose sensor tells distance have sensitivity levels. On the others it's left out, and the mode is still set.

managed_device_admin_code_configure.name: Configure device admin code (Kiosk)
managed_device_admin_code_configure.description: Set or remove the admin code on Zendo devices with Always-On Display (Kiosk) on. The devices have to be online, with a current version of the Zendo app. Only Home Assistant administrators can run this action, and a code set here shows in recorded events and traces.

device.name: Device
device.description: Required. One or more Zendo devices.

code.name: Code
code.description: The admin code to set: exactly 4, 6 or 8 digits. In YAML, put it in quotes. Give either a code or Remove.

remove.name: Remove
remove.description: Remove the admin code. Give either a code or Remove.
